name: many-small-none
why: 200 grids of 20 items: page load and scroll with the default mode

name: many-small-push
why: the same page in push mode

name: many-small-compress
why: the same page in compress mode, which compresses on registration

name: few-large-none
why: 20 grids of 200 items: per-grid costs that grow with item count

name: few-large-compress
why: 20 grids of 200 items in compress mode (9.5 s to load before compression was coalesced)

name: one-huge-none
why: a single grid of 600 items: the steepest per-grid scaling

name: many-small-fluid
why: item width from the container, so every grid is sized by its ResizeObserver

name: scroll-slow-cpu
why: 200 x 20 scrolled on a 4x slower CPU: paint and hit-testing of off-screen grids made a third of the frames slow

name: drag-large-push
why: dragging one item across a 200-item push grid, which pushes items on every move

name: drag-large-shift
why: the same drag in shift mode, which recomputes the layout around the drag from its start snapshot on every move
